primary.usage: Primary CTA ('Conseguir entrada'), 'Voy' active state, notifications

secondary.usage: 'Me interesa' active state, subtle tags, verified/friend icons

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: For premium featured events, use a subtle 1px animated gradient border.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No generic fullscreen gradients. Use sharp radial glow `bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#FF0055]/15 via-transparent to-transparent` for background ambiance.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (`mix-blend-overlay` 5% opacity) to make it feel like film/nightlife photography rather than flat digital.

layouts.mobile_first: Max width container `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative` for web view to simulate app, full width on actual mobile.
layouts.navigation: Bottom tab bar using Glassmorphism. `fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md z-50`.
layouts.feed: Vertical scroll layout `flex flex-col gap-6 pb-24 pt-4 px-4` with full-bleed styled cards.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing `p-4` or `p-6` around containers. Tight grouping inside event cards.

event_card.structure: Relative container `rounded-3xl overflow-hidden`. Base layer is the event image (`object-cover w-full h-[60vh] max-h-[500px]`). Dark gradient overlay `absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0C] via-[#0A0A0C]/80 to-transparent` covering the bottom 70%.
event_card.content: Absolute positioned at the bottom `absolute bottom-0 w-full p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 z-10`.
event_card.social_proof: Flex row with overlapping avatars `-space-x-3` and text `Marta y 2 amigos más van'. Crucial for FOMO.
event_card.actions: Grid layout `grid grid-cols-2 gap-3` for 'Voy' vs 'Me interesa' buttons.

status_toggle.voy: When active: Solid primary `bg-[#FF0055] text-white shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,0,85,0.4)]`. When inactive: outlined glass `bg-white/5 border border-white/20 text-white/70`.
status_toggle.me_interesa: When active: Solid secondary `bg-[#00F0FF] text-black shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]`. When inactive: outlined glass.

filter_chips.style: Pill-shaped `rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap`, horizontal scroll `flex overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-2`. Active chip: `bg-white text-black`. Inactive: `bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white/70`.

avatars.style: Circular, `w-8 h-8` or `w-10 h-10`, `rounded-full object-cover` with `border-2 border-[#0A0A0C]` to ensure separation when overlapping.

motion.hover_states: Buttons lift `-translate-y-1` with increased glow. Avatars slightly separate on hover.
motion.transitions: Use `transition-colors duration-300 ease-out` or `transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`.
motion.feed_entrance: Staggered fade-up animation `framer-motion` for event cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on dark overlays meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Use text-shadow if needed.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="event-voy-btn"`).

component_path.instructions: Place generic ui components in `src/components/ui/` (.jsx). Note: Use .jsx instead of .tsx since this is a JS project.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA layout. If viewed on desktop, center the app view with max-w-md and a dark atmospheric background behind it.
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered card entries and micro-interactions on the 'Voy' / 'Me interesa' toggles.
Implement the UI using pure Tailwind classes for custom layouts. Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, and dropdowns (Admin Panel).
The 'Who is going' feature is the core value proposition. Emphasize the avatars and social text visually above the venue details.
DO NOT use a fully transparent nav bar. Use the glassmorphism variables defined above.
Ensure 'Voy' and 'Me interesa' behave as mutually exclusive toggles.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the event cards to achieve the specific overlay and overlapping structures.
Remember you have .js files not .tsx files. Write React components using JSX syntax.
Always include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and forms for testability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
